prose: The tester refuses --seal when a closure file's working bytes differ from its index blob after the attributes apply, and the hook's reseal names that file. Use the scratch-repo tooth you described. Also add a second tooth: an LF tree seals clean, so the refusal doesn't fire on every file. (orchestrator, approving akienasus_cc_0's measurement: the Windows seal of test_flock_stands_for_fcntl at 52890c2f8, fp 133032682e11, is exactly the committed bytes with cairn/tools/base/__init__.py alone in CRLF; that file last changed 2026-08-13, before the *.py eol=lf pin landed 2026-11-12 19:04 (a7305b783), and git rewrites a working file under a new attribute only when it writes the file again.)
